Hi Tom —

Thanks for the questions. High-level answers below; happy to set a short technical sync if you want deeper detail.

SOC 2:
- We completed SOC 2 Type II (period: 2024-01-01 through 2025-12-31). A redacted report is attached for third-party review. Full evidence is available under NDA for in-depth assessments.

GDPR / DPA:
- We maintain a standard DPA (EU Addendum) and processes for DSARs. We can provide the DPA template and sign; configuration options exist to minimize personal data collection.

HIPAA / BAA:
- Redwood will sign a BAA for customers processing PHI. Typical approach: Hosted customers will need to scope which endpoints and logs contain PHI; Dedicated/Private options reduce exposure because telemetry can be disabled/controlled. We provide sample BAA and can execute via DocuSign.

Telemetry / Logging:
- Hosted (SaaS): We collect operational telemetry and usage metrics (aggregate request counts, latencies, feature flags). By default we also retain request metadata to support debugging and quality; model inputs are stored only if the customer opts into "data retention for quality" during onboarding. PII in inputs should be redacted by the customer when possible; we provide client-side guidance and SDK helpers.
- Dedicated / Private: Customers can opt into a "no-telemetry" profile that disables non-essential telemetry. Private (on-prem / VPC) allows customers to retain telemetry entirely in their environment.
- Retention & controls: Per-customer retention settings are configurable (30/90/365/never) and we support deletion requests. Audit logs and access are available in the Console.

Cookies / Docs site:
- Our public docs site uses GA4 for analytics and standard session cookies for site UX. Marketing cookies are not set by default for logged-in console sessions; marketing cookies are controlled via the cookie banner. For customers with strict marketing-cookie policies, we can provide a cookie-free docs bundle or host a white-labeled docs site (for large customers/partners).

Encryption & key management:
- All data in transit is TLS 1.2+; at rest we use AES-256. For Dedicated/Private we support customer-managed keys via major cloud KMS providers and HSM where required.

Attachments / links:
- Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025_redacted.pdf
- Sample DPA/BAA (link/attachment): sample_BAA_DPA.pdf
- Telemetry & privacy docs: https://redwood.example.com/docs/telemetry | https://redwood.example.com/docs/privacy

If you can upload the questionnaire (vendor_security_questionnaire.xlsx) I’ll have the security team start populating the spreadsheet with technical answers this afternoon.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security & Compliance
